title: Marcos welcomes Dutch, Swiss envoys, seeks stronger bilateral ties

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Thursday received the credentials of the ambassador-designates of the Kingdom of the Netherlands and the Swiss Confederation to the Philippines during a ceremony at Malacañang. His Excellency Roderick Wols, ambassador-designate of the Netherlands, and H.E. Edgar Doerig, ambassador-designate of the Swiss Confederation, presented their credentials to Marcos, signaling their countries’ commitment to strengthening relations with the Philippines.
